issue: Coverage-gap discovery sweep (2026-08): ran the §4.3 upstream-oil-operator/associated-gas sweep on the Falklands' only live hydrocarbon development, Sea Lion (North Falkland Basin, blocks PL032/PL004b; operator Navitas Petroleum 65% / Rockhopper Exploration 35%; FID reported December 2025; first oil targeted 2028; 18.25 million bbl/yr design capacity). Checked Navitas/Rockhopper investor materials and available Falkland Islands Government reporting for any associated-gas monetization, flaring-reduction, or FLNG plan tied to Sea Lion -- none surfaced. Public disclosures describe an oil-production-focused development with no stated gas-export component, consistent with an associated-gas reinjection-for-pressure-support plan typical of an offshore oil development with no local gas-export infrastructure (not confirmed by a direct source, but no contrary FLNG/export signal exists either). gem.wiki carries a 'Sea Lion Oil and Gas Project (Falkland Islands)' page on GEM's oil & gas EXTRACTION tracker (a different tracker, correctly out of scope here) and no LNG-terminal page for the Falklands (site-search checked and confirmed empty).
suggested_action: No candidate to stage. Re-check Sea Lion's associated-gas handling disclosures as the project moves from FID toward first oil (2028) -- an FLNG monetization plan could still emerge from an oil-focused field operator per the SOP §4.3 pattern.
